Welcome to Ikena Kai

Wake up to the sound of waves, trade winds carrying the scent of plumeria, and views that stretch to the horizon. Ikena Kai is your gateway to the raw beauty of Maui -- where volcanic landscapes meet turquoise waters, rainforests cascade down mountain slopes, and every sunset paints the sky in colors you never knew existed.

Island Living

Ikena Kai puts you at the center of Maui's natural wonders. Step outside and the island unfolds before you -- turquoise coastline, volcanic peaks, and trade winds that carry the scent of the Pacific.

  • Walk to pristine beaches with world-class snorkeling
  • Watch humpback whales breach from the shore (in season)
  • Explore Haleakala's crater at sunrise
  • Drive the legendary Road to Hana past waterfalls and rainforest
  • Parking: Driveway fits 2 cars + carport

Nature & Landscapes

Kamaole Beach5 min away. Crystal-clear water, sea turtles, and some of the best snorkeling on the island.
Haleakala National ParkDrive up for sunrise above the clouds. The volcanic crater is unlike anything you have ever seen.
Road to HanaWinding through rainforests, waterfalls, and coastal cliffs. One of the most scenic drives on earth.
Makena CoveA hidden gem with turquoise water, lava rock formations, and often sea turtles resting on the shore.
Wailea Coastal TrailA stunning oceanfront walk past lava fields, pristine beaches, and whale-watching lookouts.
